description: This file implements a Krisp noise reduction audio filter for the Pipecat project, including a singleton manager for the Krisp processor, and a deprecated filter class that applies Krisp noise suppression to audio streams.

classes.name: KrispProcessorManager
classes.description: Singleton manager for KrispAudioProcessor instances, ensuring only one instance exists.

classes.name: KrispFilter
classes.description: Audio filter class that uses Krisp's noise reduction technology, marked as deprecated.

methods.name: get_processor
methods.description: Returns a shared KrispAudioProcessor instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the KrispFilter with optional parameters, checks for model path, and issues a deprecation warning.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the Krisp processor with the given sample rate.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cleans up the Krisp processor instance.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Enables or disables filtering based on control frames.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Applies Krisp noise reduction to the input audio bytes.
